seo.title: Sunflower Bridge | Parenting Support Groups in Delray Beach
seo.description: Sunflower Bridge is a 7-week guided parenting journey, plus an alumni continuation, where families build a supportive community and share tools through Play, Nature, and the Arts in Delray Beach, FL.

hero.title: Sunflower Bridge
hero.lead: Parenting isn’t meant to be done alone. Sunflower Bridge offers weekly guided group sessions where families connect, reflect, and grow together.

sections.heading: Sunflower Bridge Journey (for families new to Bridge)
sections.html:
Now more than ever, parents and caregivers need a strong support system. Parenting can feel isolating, and we’re not meant to do it alone. That’s why we created the Sunflower Bridge Journey – a 7-week program that introduces a family-proven framework of tools while fostering real connections with other parents in the community.

At Sunflower Bridge, we believe that parenting isn’t about following an instruction manual – it’s about discovering what works best for your family through intuition and inner wisdom. This journey is a space for families to connect, reflect, and grow together. Through Play, Nature, and the Arts, we explore ways to nurture connections, build resilience, and create a foundation for lifelong strong family relationships.

Rooted in Sunflower’s Pillars: Respect for the Individual, Connection through Community, and Learning through Experience, Sunflower Bridge offers a supportive, compassionate environment where you can create lasting relationships with other families. Together, we share tools and insights to help navigate the challenges of parenting while building a strong, understanding support system.

Through weekly guided group sessions, we’ll reimagine parenting not as a solo endeavor, but as a community experience.

sections.heading: What we’ll dive into
sections.html:
• Trusting your intuition as a parent
  • Simple ways to manage stress
  • Creative problem-solving for everyday challenges
  • Understanding healthy child development
  • Communicating with compassion
  • Guidance method of discipline
  • Tools for helping children engage in independent play

items.title: Six weekly two-hour group sessions
items.html:
• Connect with a small, dedicated group of up to five other families
  • Share joys and challenges in a supportive space
  • Find real solutions with the help of our Sunflower Guides

items.title: Bridging Day celebration (seventh week)
items.html:
• Enjoy a grownups-only graduation ceremony, where we’ll play and reflect together on the twists & turns of our Journey.
  • Parents will receive a special gift to honor their Journey!

items.title: Private group chat
items.html:
• Stay connected to your group throughout the week
  • A safe, supportive space to share thoughts and experiences

items.title: Access to recorded toolboxes
items.html:
• Extra resources to revisit key concepts anytime
  • Practical guidance to support your parenting journey

items.title: Bonus!
items.html: Join Sunflower’s Early Childhood Program families for an interactive parenting & philosophy discussion! Whether in-person or on Zoom, this one-hour conversation is a chance to talk about a specific parenting topic that matters right now. Dates TBA.

sections.html: Sunflower Bridge is more than a parenting class – it’s a chance to build a stronger, more connected family while finding a supportive community along the way.

sections.heading: Sunflower Bridge Alumni (for families who have already completed the original Sunflower Bridge Journey)
sections.html:
In this 6-week continuation of the Bridge Journey, grownups share a 2-hour guided discussion while the children enjoy child-led play in our Seedlings Nature Playscape.

What we’ll dive into:

  • Building on the skills you already have
  • Challenging conversations
  • Creating routine
  • Siblings
  • Emergent topics for your group
